title: fallthrough: Describe a Number
hints: Swift cases don't fall through unless you write `fallthrough`.
Start with `"The number \(n) is"`; the prime case appends its text and falls through; `default` appends `" an integer."`.
`case 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19: description += " a prime number, and also"; fallthrough`.
